rules.applies_when: A task merges into a branch whose protection or ruleset requires approving reviews
rules.check: The merge is a dependency of the next task with the reviewer's review in waits_on; no task merges its own pull request without the required approvals

rules.applies_when: The target branch requires status checks
rules.check: A code task's verify step names the required check and its done state is that check green

rules.applies_when: A task needs a pull request approved
rules.check: The approving reviewer is a different role holder from the pull request's author; a plan never relies on the author approving their own pull request

rules.applies_when: The branch requires review from code owners and CODEOWNERS covers the changed paths
rules.check: The review wait names the code owner role from CODEOWNERS evidence

rules.applies_when: A deploy job references an environment with required reviewers
rules.check: The task after the deploy has a waits_on of kind approval owned by the reviewer's role; a rollback redeploy to the same environment needs its own approval wait

rules.applies_when: A rollback or redeploy relies on workflow_dispatch
rules.check: Evidence shows the workflow with workflow_dispatch exists on the default branch

rules.applies_when: A step needs a secret value
rules.check: No step reads, prints or copies a secret value; steps that need one name the secret and say who sets it

rules.applies_when: Both branch protection and rulesets exist on a branch
rules.check: Instructions account for every applicable rule from both sources

rules.applies_when: A task tags or deploys a release
rules.check: The task compares the commit tested on staging with the commit it releases and blocks on any difference other than planned release-notes changes
